answer: Cap a cluster's reward by its distinct output, not its headcount. The protocol fingerprints each answer, merges near-duplicates, then caps what any correlated cluster (one funding root or behavior) earns per epoch at the value of its non-redundant work. A thousand aliases paraphrasing one generator collapse to one distinct contribution and split a single cap, so headcount buys nothing. An honest agent keeps its own anchor of distinct work and earns full value. Redundant mass is squeezed to its real information content; the summit of payout tracks distinct nectar, not the mouths at the trough.
